Results.ReviewText:
I LOVE BOTH of my Webber Kettles. We bought our house in 1985 and brought our propane gas grill with us when we moved in. It died 2 years later (1987) and I bought my 1st full sized Kettle then. I loved it from day one. A couple of years later I bought my 1st table-top Weber to cook things that don't need as much charcoal, like strip steaks and pork tenderloins. Love it too. It's 2020 now and I'm still on my second table-top grill, and just bought my 3rd 22" grill. When we put the old grill on the side of the road, it was gone in 15 minutes. "One man's rash is another man's treasure.' Someone was very happy to get my "Old Girl". 

I know that I spend a penny or two more for my Webers, but they last a LONG time, they are dependable, and cook SO MUCH better than the imposters. Worth EVERY penny. I can cook a whole chicken on my 22" Kettle that comes out SO MUCH better than the expensive rotisserie chickens that people buy at the stores. Helps pay for itself not having to buy take-out or convenience foods. 

My Husband also uses my Weber to smoke fish and make jerky, YUM. Truly a versatile tool, easy to master, easy to use, AND yummy food, no culinary degree required. I won't buy anything else, ever.
Results.Title: I LOVE both my big and little Webers.

ClientResponses.Response: Hello, thank you for taking your time to submit your review! We are very sorry to hear about the experience you are having with your grill. Please know that we do stand behind our product and customer and we want you to have the best grilling experience. Your grill lid should sit nice and snug on your bowl, however if you see a small smoke escape from the lid that is fine and your food will not be affected. But your grill grate should not be falling off from the support. It should be sitting steady inside the bowl. At your convenience, please reach out to our support team and we will be happy to look into these further for you!

Results.ReviewText: With this, all things are possible. I barely had an idea what I was doing until I got this thing. This grill is so versatile it’s amazing. I smoked a pork butt last night and I’ve grilled all kinds of steaks and vegetables on here. Yeah $110 may seem a little steep, but it’s the absolute best charcoal grill you can buy AND it comes with a ten year warranty for rust and burn through. Not that you’ll need it tho my dad has been grilling on a Weber Kettle for as long as I can remember. I’m probably gonna get him another for his birthday. They’re so easy to use you’ll want to try new things and expand your grilling/bbq knowledge. This is hands down one of the best purchases I’ve made in my life.
